title: Does the Oxford Dictionary say that India means old-fashioned and criminal people? Know the truth.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
For the last few years, some people in our country are demanding to change the name of the country from India to Bharat. Regarding this case, the Supreme Court said that both the names India and Bharat have been mentioned in our constitution. The case was later dismissed.
Now a post is going viral on social media claiming that the Oxford Dictionary defines India as old-fashioned and criminal people.
But Fact Crescendo found the viral claim misleading. In the Oxford dictionary, it is not our country India which has been mentioned as old-fashioned and criminal people, but it was referring to Indians (Native Americans).
What's the claim?
Social media users are claiming that the meaning of the word Indian is illegitimate children. That's why the Britishers used to write 'Dogs and Indians are not allowed' in movie halls and many public places.
The old Oxford Dictionary also mentioned the synonym of Indian as
Old fashioned and criminal peoples
on page number 789. It was also mentioned that Indian means those whose parents were not married in a church. Such children are also considered as illegitimate children.
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
After searching on Google, we found the
Oxford Dictionary
on a
website.
We did not find the word India or Indian on page number 789 of the dictionary.
Then we searched for the publication
of the Oxford Dictionary in the year 1934.
Even in this publication, we did not find the word India mentioned in page number789. In this page, only synonyms of words beginning with 'O' were mentioned.
We found that the meaning of the words India and Indians were mentioned in
page number 580
. The meaning of India in the dictionary is â€“ a country in the Asian continent which is located in the eastern part of the Indus river and in the southern part of the Himalayan mountains.
The meaning of the word Indian in the dictionary is â€“ the original inhabitants of America and the West Indies.
The Britannica
website also states that the original inhabitants of the Americas were called Indians because Christopher Columbus repeatedly mistakenly believed that he had reached South Asia. Thinking himself correct, he started calling the people there Indios. (Indios means the people of the Indus Valley)
We also found that another Oxford Dictionaries website also referred to Indian as an old-fashioned and sometimes offensive members of a Native American race.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be misleading. It is true that Oxford Dictionary described Indian as old-fashioned and criminal people, but it did not refer to our country India or us as Indians. The synonym given by the dictionary referred to Indians (Native Americans)

title: No, Devendra Fadnavis Did Call Savarkar A Homosexual; Clipped Video Viral
author: Mayur Deokar
content:
A video of Maharashtra Deputy CM Devendra Fadnavis is going viral on social media. In the video, Fadnavis can be seen making derogatory remarks about Vinayak Damodar Savarkar.
The video is being shared with the claim that Fadnavis insulted the Hindutva ideologue V D Savarkar in the Maharashtra Assembly.
Fact Crescendo received this video with fact-check requests on our
WhatsApp Tipline (9049053770)
.
We found that the video is clipped. A selectively edited clip is being peddled with a false claim.
WHAT'S THE CLAIM?
In a 10-second clip, Devendra Fadnavis says, "Veer Savarkar was an apologist, Veer Savarkar was homosexual, Veer Savarkar was not a freedom fighter."
Original Tweet
FACT-CHECK
Since the logo of the Marathi news channel ABP Majha is visible in the viral clip, we looked for the original video on their YouTube channel.
Subsequently, we found a complete clip of Devendra Fadnavis's speech given in the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly on 2 August.
In this unedited video, Devendra Fadnavis was addressing the controversial statements made by right-wing leader Sambhaji Bhide concerning Mahatma Gandhi.
Sambhaji Bhide, the leader of Shiv Pratishthan Hindustan, reportedly claimed that Mahatma Gandhi was "brought up and educated by Muslim parents."
The Congress party has strongly objected to Bhide's offensive comments and has called for his arrest. Congress MLAs also raised this matter in both chambers of the state legislature on 2 August.
In response, Devendra Fadnavis said, "Though Sambhaji Bhide does noble work but he has no authority to make such a statement against an idol of the country."
Fadnavis reassured that appropriate measures would be taken in response to Bhide's actions. Additionally, he mentioned that action will also be taken against the Congress publication 'Shidori' for its objectionable comments targeting Hindutva ideologue V D Savarkar.
"Objectionable articles have been written against Veer Savarkar in the Congress mouthpiece 'Shidori', which state that Veer Savarkar was a 'maafiveer' (apologist); he was a homosexual and did not take part in the freedom struggle. So, similar action will be taken against 'Shidori'," Fadnavis said.
In a comparative video, it becomes evident that Fadnavis was citing an article from the 'Shidori' newspaper. The remarks were not of his own making.
Nandkishore Kuyate, the Congress state secretary, filed a formal complaint against Bhide at the Rajapeth police station. Later, Bhide and two of his associates were charged under Sections 153 A, 500, 505 (2), and 34 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC). Another FIR was also registered against Bhide in Nashik.
CONCLUSION
It is clear that an edited video clip is being circulated with a false claim that Devendra Fadnavis insulted Savarkar by labeling him as homosexual and an apologist. In reality, Fadnavis was referencing an article in which these statements were made.

title: Video Of Makeup Workshop Shared As A Live Test By The Groom's Family To Test The Bride's Beauty.

title: Old image from MP shared linking to Haryana Demolitions
author: Usha Manoj
content:
The image is from demolitions that followed the communal violence in Khargone, MP, in April 2022.
Amidst the violence in Haryana's Nuh, to crack down on the rioters, the administrators demolished illegally constructed buildings. The bulldozer had already thundered about 753 constructions to the ground. However, last day the High Court reprimanded the Haryana government and ordered a ban on bulldozers. Meanwhile a viral image has been circulating on social media, claiming to show a Muslim man gazing at his destroyed home.
The caption reads "A helpless Muslim man from Nuh, Haryana, watching his home's demolition by the government."
Facebook Post
|
Archive link
Fact Check-
By performing the reverse image search on Google led us to a report by the
Scroll
dated 19 October, 2022. The report titled "Khargone violence: 12-year-old boy asked to pay Rs 2.9 lakh for allegedly damaging public property" contained the viral image. The caption accompanying the photo read: "A person's house in Khargone being demolished." The photo's source was listed as a "Special arrangement".
On April 10, 2022, communal clashes broke out in
Khargone
after alleged stone-pelting at a Ram Navami procession. One person died in the violence, and 24 were injured, following which the Madhya Pradesh government demolished houses and shops belonging to Muslims claiming they were involved in the stone-pelting.
In further search we found a report in the
Free Press Journal
dated 11 April , 2022. The report titled "Bhopal: Khargone rioters will not be spared: Chief Minister" also featured the same viral image.
Regardless, the presence of the viral image on the internet since April 2022 confirms that it could not have been related to the demolition drive following the violence in Nuh, Haryana. We could not independently verify the source of this image; however, it is at least as old as April 2022.
Conclusion-
Fact Crescendo found the claim made along with the viral images to be
False
. The viral image is not related to the demolition drive following the violence in Haryana. The image is from demolitions that followed the communal violence in Khargone, MP, in April 2022.

title: The video does not show people illegally entering Manipur from Myanmar
author: Usha Manoj
content:
The video shows the lives of a nomadic family and their journey across the Iranian mountains, not people illegally entering Manipur from Myanmar.
Manipur is still raging amid ongoing ethnic clashes between the Meiteis and the Kukis. While addressing the violence in Manipur, Union Home Minister Amit Shah alleged that the conflict in Myanmar led to many Kukis crossing over from Myanmar into Manipur. He said that the political instability in Myanmar had prompted thousands of refugees to flee into Manipur across a porous border. Minister further added that this influx of people from Myanmar led to anxieties among the majority Meitei population in Manipur.
On this backdrop a video showing a group of people including women and children
moving from one place to another by climbing mountains has gone viral on the internet. Those sharing the video have claimed that it shows people from Myanmar entering Manipur illegally. The caption states, "Thief road from Myanmar to Manipur. How come to India by risking their lives to save their lives and spoil the atmosphere of India here. This six kilometer road has to be completed in a day".
Facebook Post
Archive link
Fact Check-
A reverse image search on Google with the key frames from the viral video led us to a Facebook post from April this year carrying the same video. The video was uploaded with Kurdish captions mentioning that the people in the video are Kurdish, an ethnic group who reside in the mountainous region of Kurdistan.
Facebook Post
In further search we found a longer version of the video on a Turkish YouTube channel called DENA on 12 March, 2023. The channel mentioned that the video is from Iran and uploaded the video with the caption, "An Iranian nomadic family with three young children travels a difficult path to reach their destination".
Next, we checked the channel description, which said something like, "Welcome to Dana channel, Dana channel shows the life of Iranian nomads." There are numerous videos on this channel page that describe the nomadic mountain life of the people who live in Mount Dena, which is a sub-range of the Zargos Mountains in Iran.
We also compared the visuals from the viral clip and the video uploaded on the Turkey-based YouTube channel. You can see a comparison of both images below.
Conclusion-
Fact Crescendo found that the claim made along with the viral video to be
False
. The video shows the lives of a nomadic family and their journey across the Iranian mountains, not people illegally entering Manipur from Myanmar.

title: Is this video of a cow attacking a girl an incident from Faridabad? Know the truth.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:

Suddenly, a couple of nearby cows started attacking a girl and trampled her. After a lot of intervention, few people were able to rescue the girl.
It was claimed that this incident took place in Faridabad, Haryana.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be misleading. This incident is not from Haryana but from Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
What's the claim?
Social media users are claiming that this incident of cows attacking a small girl is from Saidpur, Faridabad. The girl was severely injured in the incident and few people from the neighborhood rescued her.
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
A Google Reverse Image Search on a keyframe of the viral video led us to the same video uploaded on Punjab Kesari â€“ Madhya Pradesh/Chhattisgarh official Facebook page. It was mentioned that this incident is from Chennai when a small school girl was attacked by cows. Later, people had to intervene and rescue the girl.
According to the
Hindustan Times
report, this incident took place in MMRDA Colony, Chennai. The girl was returning from school with her sibling and her mother. As they were crossing the cow and its calf, the cow suddenly attacked her and injured her severely. Some men tried to rescue the girl by throwing stones at the cow and scaring it. The owner of the cow was imposed a fine of 25,000 rupees by the authorities and the cow is under observation to ascertain if it is suffering from some kind of disease. Police also arrested the owner of the cow after a complaint was filed by victim's mother. The girl is being treated in a hospital.
Below you can see the video of the incident.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be misleading. The incident of the cow attacking a girl is from Chennai and not from Faridabad.

title: The video of a tiger taking a bath in a bathtub at a coffee plantation is from North Carolina in US, not from Coorg in Karnataka
author: Usha Manoj
content:
The video is from Carolina Tiger Rescue sanctuary in North Carolina, US, and it dates back to June 2020.
Tigers are some of the most amazing creatures on the world, as well as one of nature's most powerful and feared predators. A video of a tiger sitting in a rubber tub filled with water in a forest area has gone viral on social media, with the claim that the tiger was spotted at a coffee plantation in Coorg, Karnataka.
In the video, we can see the tiger inspecting a black-coloured tub filled with water. After standing at a point for a few seconds, it walks around the tub, carefully inspecting the sides and perhaps the sturdiness of the tub. Once the tiger is seemingly satisfied, it is seen stepping inside the tub and relaxing in it. The caption of the video states, "At a coffee plantation in Coorg in Southern India. A visitor inspects his bath".
Facebook Post
Archive link
The post has gone viral and has been shared widely on Facebook.
Fact Check-
A simple reverse image search on Google using the key frames from the viral video led us to a tweet by an organization called Carolina Tiger Rescue based in the United States. The organization uploaded this video of the tiger taking a bath on all their social media accounts on 11June, 2020. The caption to their post reads "Madonna Tiger received her pool yesterday! Pools are one of the ways we help the cats stay cool during the summer, and clearly they love it. Madonna, while known for her hiding and stalking skills, may be easier to find now that she has her summertime tub to relax in!"
Madonna Tiger received her pool yesterday! Pools are one of the ways we help the cats stay cool during the summer, and clearly they love it. Madonna, while known for her hiding and stalking skills, may be easier to find now that she has her summertime tub to relax in!

June 11, 2020
Carolina Tiger Rescue
In further search we found the same video uploaded by Carolina Tiger Rescue on YouTube on 28 May, 2021, which was filmed from a different angle. The video was titled "Madonna Tiger gets her pool (2021)", and the description states "Last year, our video of Madonna Tiger receiving her first pool of the summer went viral on Facebook!! It's been viewed 5 million times and liked by nearly 150,000 people. So, we'd be remiss if we didn't share Madonna's first pool video from this year!"
According to the website of
Carolina Tiger Rescue
,
Madonna the tiger was rescued from Alabama, a southeastern region of the United States in September 2014 and who passed away recently this year,

Fact Crescendo found the claim made along with the viral video to be
False
. The video is neither from India nor recent. The video is from Carolina Tiger Rescue sanctuary in North Carolina, US, and it dates back to June 2020.

title: Did a fight break out in a cinema hall in Bareilly after a viewer raised a pro-Pakistan slogan? Know the truth.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
The movie
Gadar 2
starring
Sunny Deol
and
Ameesha Patel
was released nationwide a few days ago. A video of the inside of a movie theatre is now going viral on social media where a group of people can be seen fighting with each other.
It was claimed that during the screening of the movie, a viewer raised a pro-Pakistan slogan. A few other audiences got offended by the slogan and beat the person severely inside the cinema hall.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. There was no pro-Pakistan slogan raised during the movie.
What's the claim?
Sharing the video, social media users are claiming that some Jihadis chanted Pakistan Zindabad slogans during Gadar 2 show in a cinema hall in the Bareilly district of Uttar Pradesh. After that, the crowd beat them up with belts.
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
A keyword search on Google led us to
The Free Press Journal
report on 13 August 2023. According to the report, this incident took place at Prasad Cinema hall in Bareilly district of Uttar Pradesh. Due to some reasons, a fight broke out between two individuals who were in an intoxicated state watching the movie. During the fight, nearby audiences were also injured. The accused had already fled before police reached the site.
A video of the incident was also uploaded on City News Bareilly's YouTube channel. According to the report, this incident took place at Prasad cinema hall in Bareilly during the last show of the day. The fight broke out between two intoxicated people watching Gadar 2 movie where both the individuals started hitting each other with belts. Few other audiences also got injured during the fight. Both the people who started the fight fled after police reached the site.
After this, Fact Crescendo contacted SHO Dharmendra Singh of Thana Kotwali. He informed us that the claim going viral on social media is false. During the movie, a person from the audience tried to take a photo/video of his favorite scene. Another person in the hall objected him which resulted in an enraged conversation and argument and later changed to a fight. There was no pro-Pakistan slogan raised in the hall in Prasad Theatre in Bareilly.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be misleading. There was no pro-Pakistan slogan raised during Gadar 2 movie screening at Prasad Theatre in Bareilly. A fight broke out between two intoxicated people over the video capturing a scene from the movie.

title: UDGAM Portal: Here's How You Can Check Your Unclaimed Deposits In Banks
author: Mayur Deokar
content:
Have you ever experienced the delightful surprise of reaching into the pocket of an old pair of jeans only to find a forgotten Rs 100 note? What an unexpected joy is that!
Well, imagine that same feeling, but on a much grander scale. Imagine learning that you or your deceased family members have money lying in bank accounts for decades â€“ money you had no idea even existed.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has pulled off something similar to those pocket-moments with its new UDGAM portal.
RBI has introduced a centralized web portal called UDGAM (Unclaimed Deposits â€“ Gateway to access information) to help citizens search for their unclaimed deposits. UDGAM makes it easier to search unclaimed deposits across multiple banks in one place.
It's as if RBI has scoured the nation's financial pockets for us to find our long-lost money hiding in the coffers of the banking system. Just like discovering crumpled cash in old pants, UDGAM initiative promises to help us find unclaimed deposits that might have slipped through the cracks of our memory.
RBI launches à¤‰à¤¦à¥à¤—à¤® â€“ UDGAM â€“ Centralised Web Portal for searching Unclaimed Deposits
https://t.co/CGhsVm9ICJ
â€” ReserveBankOfIndia (@RBI)
August 17, 2023
What Is UDGAM?
UDGAM (à¤‰à¤¦à¥à¤—à¤®) stands for "Unclaimed Deposits â€“ Gateway to Access inforMation."
The portal was initially announced by the RBI in a statement on 6 April 2023, as part of its developmental and regulatory policies.
The primary aim of the UDGAM portal is to make it easy for people to search for information regarding their unclaimed deposits. It's like a one-stop place where you can find old accounts that you haven't used for a while.
The RBI wants to make more people aware of this and make it simple for them to find their lost money or make their old accounts active again.
Seven Banks Available
Currently, the portal provides information related to unclaimed deposits from seven banks. These banks are:
State Bank of India,
Punjab National Bank,
South Indian Bank,
Central Bank of India,
Dhanlaxmi Bank,
DBS Bank India,
CitiBank N.A.
The information for other banks will be gradually integrated into the portal in a phased manner, with the search functionality for remaining banks expected to be available by 15 October 2023.
What Is Unclaimed Deposit?
Unclaimed deposits are funds that you have in bank accounts that have been inactive or dormant for a long time and you haven't used or taken back.
According to RBI, if you don't operate a savings or current account for 10 years, or if a fixed deposit isn't claimed within 10 years after its maturity date, the bank classifies these as "Unclaimed Deposits."
The reasons for deposits becoming unclaimed can vary. For example, you might forget about an account you opened, change your contact details without telling the bank, or even if you pass away and your family doesn't know about the accounts.
As time goes by and if you don't use or communicate about the account, the rules require banks to consider these accounts as inactive or unclaimed. These amounts are transferred by banks to 'Depositor Education and Awareness" (DEA) Fund maintained by RBI.
What Was The Need For UDGAM?
The decision to create such a portal was prompted by the increasing amount of unclaimed deposits in the banking system.
As of February 2023, public sector banks (PSBs) had approximately Rs 35,000 crore of unclaimed deposits which they handed over to RBI. These unclaimed deposits were linked to accounts that hadn't been active for 10 years or even longer.
Minister of State for Finance Bhagwat Karad
informed
the Lok Sabha that around 10.24 crore such inactive accounts were moved to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
With Rs 8,086 crore, State Bank of India (SBI) is at the top with the highest amount of unclaimed deposits. After that, there's Punjab National Bank with Rs 5,340 crore, and then Canara Bank with Rs 4,558 crore. Lastly, Bank of Baroda has unclaimed deposits totalling Rs 3,904 crore.
How to Use UDGAM Portal?
To begin, visit the website of
UDGAM portal
.
You will need to register or create an account on the portal. Give your mobile number, name, chosen password, and complete the CAPTCHA. Following submission, you'll receive a One-Time Password (OTP) on the mobile number you registered.
Once your account is set up, you can proceed to check unclaimed deposits.
Upon logging in to the portal, you will be directed to a page where you can choose between two options:
Individual for Accounts belonging to a person.
Non-individual for Accounts belonging to HUF, proprietorship, partnership, firm company
If you're searching for unclaimed deposits linked to an individual, you'll need to provide the account holder's name, the name of the relevant bank(s) holding the deposits, and at least one search criterion. You can choose from options such as PAN, Voter ID, Driving License Number, Passport Number, or Date of Birth. You can also provide your address as an additional search criteria.
For a non-individual search, you'll be required to provide the name of the entity and at least one piece of information from the following options: Name of the Authorized Signatory, PAN, corporate identification number (CIN), or date of Incorporation.
After entering the required information, simply click the "Search" button.
The portal will then display any unclaimed deposits associated with the provided details.
Last Word
The UDGAM portal is a big step to deal with the issue of unclaimed deposits. This easy-to-use website helps people find money they left in banks. It's like a helpful tool to find old money and bring back accounts they haven't used for a while. The UDGAM portal makes it simple to look for lost money in different banks and helps more people know about their finances. As more banks join the portal, it will become even more useful in bringing back unclaimed deposits for people, which is a great way to make sure everyone's money is safe and easy to access.

title: Is this an image of a recent military vehicle accident in Ladakh? Know the truth
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
A tragic accident of a military vehicle in Ladakh took the precious lives of a Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) and 8 soldiers. This accident took place in the Nyoma region of Ladakh when a military vehicle skidded off the road and fell into a deep valley.
In the backdrop of this, an image of a damaged military vehicle is going viral on social media. It was claimed that this is an image of the recent accident that happened in Ladakh.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be misleading. This is not an image of the recent accident in Ladakh, but an old image from Sikkim.
What's the claim?
Sharing the image, social media users are claiming that this is an image of a recent accident of a military vehicle in Ladakh. This happened in Kyari town and 9 soldiers lost their lives. The troops were moving from Karu garrison to Kyari near Leh.
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
A Google Reverse Image Search on the viral image led us to the
Hindustan Times
report published on 23 December 2022. According to the report, this incident took place in North Sikkim. 16 soldiers lost their lives in this accident. The truck carrying soldiers was moving from Chatten towards Thangu. The truck skidded down a steep slope and fell into a gorge.
The same visual of the accident can also be seen on The Economic Times YouTube channel. On 23 December The Economic Times reported that on the same day an army vehicle met with an accident in Zema in North Sikkim. 16 soldiers lost their lives in this accident. A 3-vehicle convoy was moving from Chatten to Thangu when one of the vehicles skidded on a steep slope while taking a sharp turn. A rescue operation was carried out and 4 soldiers were evacuated
Army vehicle accident in Leh
According to
India Today
, 9 soldiers lost their lives when the vehicle carrying them skidded off the road and fell into a deep gorge. One JCO and eight soldiers were killed in this tragic accident that happened on 19 August near Kyari town in Leh.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be misleading. Although it is true that a tragic accident of an army vehicle took place in Leh but the image getting viral is not of the same incident. The viral image is from Sikkim last year.

title: Did Dubai government refused to light Pakistan's flag on Burj Khalifa on the occasion of its Independence Day? Know the truth

Facebook
|
Archive

Daily Pakistan
website. According to the report, on the eve of Pakistan's Independence Day, many Pakistanis went to Burj Khalifa to watch their national flag lighted up at Burj Khalifa. title: 2019 video Viral as Recent Coverage of Chandrayaan 3 by BBC

content:

This achievement made India the first country in the world to land a spacecraft on the South Pole of the lunar surface. The event was followed by a flood of congratulatory messages directed towards the scientists of the Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO), who made this remarkable feat possible.
Amidst the celebrations on social media surrounding this achievement, a video of BBC's coverage of the Indian Moon Mission was shared. The video depicted the BBC News Presenter posing a question to his Indian Correspondent, "I think that more than 700 million Indians lack access to a toilet. However, upon conducting a thorough fact-check of the video, we discovered that it is indeed a segment from the BBC. However, it does not pertain to the Chandrayaan 3 mission. Rather, the coverage dates back to 2019, when India launched the Chandrayaan 2 mission. Here is the fact check.
Fact Check

same day

Chandrayaan 3 has propelled India into an exclusive league of countries that have achieved the remarkable feat of landing a spacecraft on the lunar surface. The video that has been widely circulated on social media, purported to be BBC's coverage of Chandrayaan 3, has been revealed to be outdated through our investigation. The video in question actually pertains to a BBC coverage from 2019, focusing on Chandrayaan 2.

title: Animation Video Viral As Moon Landing Footage of Chandrayaan-3 By NASA
author: Mayur Deokar
content:
Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) achieved a milestone on 23 August as the Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully
touched down
on the Moon's surface. India has become the first country to successfully land in the southern polar region of the Moon and the fourth one to achieve a soft landing on the Moon, after the US, Russia, and China.
In the midst of jubilant celebrations, a video depicting a moon landing went viral on social media. It has been claimed that NASA released the footage that shows the real landing of Chandrayaan-3 on the Moon.
Fact Crescendo received this video with fact-check requests on our
WhatsApp Tipline (9049053770)
.
We found that the claim along with the viral video is false. The video is, in fact, an animated representation of the Apollo 11 moon landing.
WHAT'S THE CLAIM?
In the viral video, you can see a spacecraft flying over the Moon and then gently landing on the Moon's surface.
Users are sharing this video with a claim that it shows Chandrayaan-3 landing on the Moon, and the American space agency NASA released this video.
Original Post â€“
Facebook
|
Facebook
|
Twitter
FACT-CHECK
In the video, there's a voice that says, "Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed."
Using keyword search, we learned that astronaut Neil Armstrong had said this line when the Apollo 11 successfully landed on the Moon in 1969.
On 20 July 1969, astronauts Neil Armstrong and Edwin Aldrin became the first humans to set foot on the Moon's surface.
We found the actual
audio file
on NASA's website, along with a detailed transcript of the mission.
Towards the end of the viral video, you can also hear the line: "Roger, Tranquility. We copy you on the ground. You got a bunch of guys about to turn blue. We're breathing again. Thanks a lot."
Original Website â€“
NASA
This makes us wonder why would NASA use audio from the Apollo Mission for the supposed Chandrayaan-3 moon landing video.
Using Google reverse image search, we found a video on YouTube from 2021. It turns out that the viral clip comes from this older YouTube video.
The uploader of the video, Haze Gray Art, clearly said in the video's title that it's about the Apollo 11 moon Landing. You can watch a longer version of this video
here
.
This YouTube channel usually shares videos about space missions and such things.
The video that's being shared is not actually showing a real moon landing. Instead, it's made using animation.
Haze Gray Art had mentioned on Twitter back in 2018 that he creates these animation videos using computer graphics. They are not actual recordings of the event. It's more like a creative visualization.

On 23 August at 6.04 pm, Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully

on the Moon's surface.

content:
Chandrayan 3 landed on the moon on 23 August. After that, the Pragyan rover started sending images of various locations on the moon. Many social media users are sharing images and videos claiming the visuals to be of the moon sent by Chandrayan 3. Fact Crescendo previously debunked many such videos.
Currently, another video is going viral on social media. The black-and-white video shows the barren lands of a heavenly body. It was claimed that this was the first video sent by Chandrayan 3 from the moon.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. This is an old video of Mars sent by the Curiosity rover. These visuals are not of the moon.
Social media users are sharing this video claiming, "
Chandrayan 3 sent its first video from the Moon. See the amazing view of the moon.
"
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
First, we looked at the viral video carefully. We saw many instances where it was mentioned that this is a video of Mars captured by the Curiosity rover. At another timeframe (0.25 minutes), it was mentioned that an ancient pond that existed on Mars millions of years ago was captured by the Curiosity rover.
We know that the name of the rover of the Lunar mission is Pragyan rover and not the Curiosity rover. This raised our suspicion of the authenticity of the claim.
To get more clarity, we searched for the Curiosity rover mission on YouTube. We found a video uploaded on a YouTube Channel on 8 August 2023. The description of the video reads, "
NASA's Mars Rover Curiosity sent latest Live captured remarkable stunning 360-degree real panorama images in 4k resolutions from Mars Planet during the Mars 2023 missions. All panoramic scenes made up of several images of Mars taken by onboard Mast cameras (panoramic cam) on sol 3899 and 3090 during the NASA Mars mission.
"
In the above video, we can see the visuals of the viral video from 0.19 minutes to 4.13 minutes. Upon comparing the viral video with the YouTube video, we found a few similarities between them. In both the videos we can see the same oval-shaped crater and rock structures. Below you can see the comparison.
We found a zoom-out image of a scene from the viral video on
NASA's
website as well. According to the information, this image was captured by Curiosity Rover in a location named Jau on Mars on 25 July 2023. This image is of a crater which was captured on the 3,899
th
Martian day of the mission. The width of the crater is 60 feet or 18 meters. This video was made up of 129 images that were sent back to the Earth by the Curiosity rover.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. The viral video is from Mars that was captured by NASA's Curiosity rover and not of the moon. Video from Mars was falsely shared as visuals captured by Chandrayan 3 from the Moon.

title: Is this an image of the Earth taken by Chandrayan 3 from the Lunar surface? Know the truth.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
On 23 August, Chandrayan 3 landed on the surface of the moon. Soon after it started sending images back to the Earth. Many social media users are sharing the images of the Earth and moon claiming it to be captured by Chandrayan 3.
One such image is now circulating on various social media platforms. It was claimed that this is an image captured by Chandrayan 3 after landing on the moon.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. This is an edited image in which the earth was shown flat. The original image was captured in 1968 by NASA's Apollo 8
Facebook
|
Archive
The same post was shared by many verified Twitter accounts which you can see
here
and
here
Fact Check-
First we tried to find out where this image started getting viral. We found that this image was posted on
9GAG
website on 19 August. This image was satirically posted to mock those people who believe that the earth is flat. This post says that this is exactly how the earth looks to some foolish people.
A Google Reverse Image Search on the viral image led us to a similar image published on
Time's
website. But in this image the shape of the earth is round and not flat. This image was published on 30 July 2021.
According to the report, this image was captured from space during the Apollo 8 mission. In the year 1968, in the Apollo 8 mission, humans were sent to space for the first time. Astronauts who were in this mission took this image of the earth rising from behind the moon
A Google keyword search led us to a video uploaded on NASA's YouTube Channel. In this video we found the same visual at 3.55 minutes. This video was uploaded on 11 December 2018 which told the story of the Apollo 8 mission.
The description of the video reads, "
50 years ago, three NASA astronauts embarked on a journey that would take them "Round the moon and back". The Apollo 8 mission proved the performance of the command and service module. This historic mission launched on December 21, 1968 to demonstrate a lunar trajectory and was the first manned launch of the Saturn V rocket. On Christmas Eve, Frank Borman, Jim Lovell, and Bill Anders were the first humans to orbit the Moon and the first to see an Earthrise above its surface.
"
Below you will find the similarities between the viral image and the image taken from NASA's YouTube Channel.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. The real image was captured during NASA's Apollo 8 mission in 1968. This is not an image taken by Chandrayan 3. The viral image was edited and the image of the earth was distorted. In the real image the shape of the earth is round.

title: This video does not show a woman collector in Karnataka state wearing a burqa during a flag hoisting ceremony on Independence Day.

content:

The users who shared the video added a communal angle also to the video, as they explain that a wrong vote can convert the whole country dominated by a specific community.
The caption states, "A single wrong vote of Hindus can turn the country into an Islamic country. A beginning has already been made in the state of Karnataka, while hoisting the flag, a collector wearing a burqa took the saluteâ€¦ a new beginning. Do you understand something or not..Being an IAS officer she violated the dress code action can be initiated. Wrong precedence."
Facebook Post
|
Archive link
The post was widely shared on Facebook.
Fact Check
When we observed the video carefully, we were able to identify the name 'Kishtwar' on the 77th Independence Day banner and 'Chowgan ground, Kishtwar'. Keeping this in mind, we conducted a reverse image search using one of the video's key frames and the results led us to a video report by
Munsif daily
. The caption states "Video of Burqa Clad VC DDC Hoisting Flag, Inspecting Independence Day Parade, Goes Viral". As per the report "The 77th Independence Day celebrations in District Kishtwar were marked by exuberance and national pride. However, the event took an unexpected turn when the Vice-Chairperson of the District Development Council, Saima Parveen Lone, hoisted the tricolor while donning a burqa and face hijab, sparking conversations amidst the ongoing anti-hijab movement in India"

Conclusion-
Fact Crescendo found that the claim made along with the viral video to be
Misleading.
The woman officer seen in the video is not the collector from Karnataka state; she is vice chairman of the District Development Council in Kishtwar, Jammu & Kashmir

title: Is this a video of Japanese police catching a woman holding knives in a public place? Know the truth
author: Usha Manoj
content:
A video of a few police personnel trying to catch a woman is going viral on social media. It can be seen in the video that the woman is holding knives in both of her hands. Police are trying to catch her with shields and plastic boxes. It was claimed that this incident was from Japan.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. This is an incident from China and not Japan.
What's the claim?
Sharing the video, social media users are claiming that police are trying to catch a woman holding knives in Japan. One user wrote, "
The Japanese police are afraid to approach a woman. It's said that there, anyone could be a descendant of a samurai.
"
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
After a close look at the video, we found the name of a shop written in the background. With the help of Google Lens, we searched for the shop. We found that the name of the shop is DaShenLin Pharmaceutical and it is written in the Chinese language.
A keyword search led us to a
website
where it was mentioned that DaShenLin Pharmacy is located in Haizhu district in Guangzhou, China. We also found that the image of the shop in the website is same to the visual in the video. Below you can see the comparison.
According to China's
media report
, this incident took place in Guangzhou in Guangdong province on 14 August. A woman attacked a few police officers in a busy street with two knives that she was holding in her hands. After the confrontation failed, police had to capture her using hooks and trapping her legs. Police still did not give any clarification on why the woman in the video attacked them.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. The incident of a woman attacking a few police officers on the street is not from Japan but from China.

title: BJP flag at the India vs Pakistan Asia cup match in Sri Lanka- know the truth
author: Usha Manoj
content:

India.com

The final of the ICC World Test Championship was played between India and Australia from June 7 to June 11, 2023, at The Oval, London, which Australia won by 209 runs. title: Video of spectators chanting 'Bharat Tere Tukde Hogeâ€¦' at Gautam Gambhir is Edited
author: Harish Nair
content:
A video has gone viral since yesterday, showing former Indian cricketer and Lok Sabha MP, Gautam Gambhir, making an obscene gesture at spectators. The spectators were trolling him, which made Gambhir irate. This created controversy and prompted the Delhi MP to explain his actions. Gambhir stated that the spectators were raising anti-India slogans, and unable to tolerate disrespect for his country, he reacted instinctively. You can hear Gambhir's defense of his actions in the following video.
Following this, a video, alleged to be the actual clip of the incident, surfaced on X (formerly Twitter). In the video, slogans of 'Bharat Tere Tukde Hogeâ€¦' meaning 'India will break into pieces' can be heard. Twitter users who shared this video claimed that it is the genuine clip, and anti-India slogans are clearly audible.
https://twitter.com/Sidha_memer/status/1698733837612978456
Archived Tweet
However, when we investigated the video, we found that the audio in the actual video has been edited. Here's the detailed fact-check.
Fact Check
A watermark can be seen in the video. The watermark is of the X handle of the user who created it @xTripti. When we searched for this user, we found her account which is now deleted.
However, when the video went viral, she had clarified in a post that she had made this video for fun and gaining impressions. The screenshot of her post is still available on social media.
We did a keyword search on YouTube for the slogans of 'Bharat Tere Tukde Hogeâ€¦'. This lead us to a video posted by Aaj Tak on 15 Feb 2016. The description of the video says, "
ABVP has released a new video which show a group of JNU students allegedly shouting anti-national slogans
." Here's the video for your reference.
After 33 seconds into the video, you can hear the slogan 'Bharat Tere Tukde Hogeâ€¦' This slogan is what we hear in the viral video as well. You can listen to the clipped video given below for better understanding. It is clear that this audio has been used to replace the audio in the original clip.
Thus, the user had taken the audio from this 7-year-old clip to edit the original video. In the original video, spectators can be heard chanting the name of former Indian Skipper Virat Kohli. We can see Gambhir walking out of the stadium when the spectators start chanting 'Kohli' directed at him. Gambhir responds to these chants by making an obscene gesture and then walks off. A comparison between the edited and the original video is shown below.
Conclusion
The video widely shared, showing spectators allegedly raising anti-India slogans directed at former Indian Cricketer and Member of Parliament Gautam Gambhir, has been edited. The original video does not contain any anti-India chants. An X user created this video by editing out the audio of the original clip and replacing it with the audio from a 7-year-old video.

title: The leopard in the video is not in an intoxicated state. He was suffering from a serious disease.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
Recently, a video of a leopard walking along with a crowd is going viral on social media. It can also be seen that people are touching the leopard and taking selfies with it. The most surprising thing is that the leopard is not reacting to anything.
Social media users are claiming that this is an incident from Taragarh village where a leopard drank alcohol and is in an intoxicated state.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. The leopard was in poor health and extremely sick.
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
A Google keyword search led us to a report published by ABP News on 1 September 2023. According to the report, The incident took place near Ikalera forest in Dewas district of Madhya Pradesh. At first, people were afraid to see this tiger. But after seeing the tiger in such a sluggish condition, they surrounded it and started taking selfies and harassing it.
After receiving the news, the forest department officials reached the spot and rescued the leopard. According to information, the animal was extremely sick. He was taken to Indore Zoo where he was treated. According to the doctor, he was suffering from a neurotic disease. In this disease, animals forget their identity.
Another report of the same incident was also found on TV9 Bharatvarsh's official YouTube channel.
To know more about this incident, Fact Crescendo contacted
Indore Zoo
. They informed us that the claims on social media are false. The leopard was terribly sick from a neurotic disease known as Canine Distemper. It is a very serious disease and surviving from it is nearly impossible. The animal was under treatment in the Indore zoo for two days and later the leopard was handed over to the Forest Department.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. The leopard was not intoxicated but was suffering from a neurotic disease known as Canine Distemper.

title: This video does not a fashion show held at the 2023 Burning Man festival in US
author: Usha Manoj
content:
Viral video is from a Balenciaga fashion show held in October 2022, it has no link to the Burning Man festival.
Burning Man 2023 was a week-long gathering in the Black Rock Desert in Pershing County, Nevada. The 35th Burning Man event, it took place from August 27 to September 4, 2023. An estimated 73,000 people attended the festival. It has been extended for a day due to a rainstorm that hit the region on September 1. The unexpected rains turned the site into mud, leaving attendees stuck and having to conserve food, water, and fuel. Following this, social media users shared images and videos of a fashion show, claiming that they were from the Burning Man festival.
In one of the videos shared widely showed a woman in black attire tramping through the mud, and the caption states, "Check this cat walk over thick mud at the Burning Man festival in Nevada in the midst of natural disasters like flood and purported Ebola. #Nevada #LasVegas #BurningMan #BurningMan2023 #burningmanebola"
Twitter link
|
Archive link
Fact Check
We began our investigation using reverse image search with the key frames of the video and the results led us to video uploaded to a YouTube channel on October 3, 2022. According to the channel, the video was from the Paris Fashion Week.
According to
Forbes
, the Balenciaga show, titled "The Mud Show," was held during Paris Fashion Week in 2022 to display the fashion house's Spring 2023 collection. The Forbes report shared a photo of the model seen in the viral video with the caption, "The Balenciaga Spring '23 Lariat dress backstage." A feature in the American fashion magazine
Vogue
identified the model shown in the viral footage and Balenciaga show as Finnish model Minttu Vesala.
In further search we found multiple media
reports
from October 2022 that had carried photos and videos similar to the now viral clip.
According to the
New York Times report
, the video was from the Paris Fashion Week show held in October 2022 in a muddy pit. This particular show was organised by the high-end fashion brand Balenciaga. The show was a "metaphor for digging for the truth and being down to earth".
Conclusion
Fact Crescendo found the claim made along with the viral video to be
False.
Viral video is from Balenciaga show, titled "The Mud Show," which was held during Paris Fashion Week in October 2022. It has no link to the Burning Man festival.

title: Indonesian public transport campaign shared as zombie virus outbreak in China
author: Usha Manoj
content:
This video is from a campaign by the rail transit agency in Indonesia to promote the use of public transport.
A video that shows what appears to be frightened passengers aboard a train screaming and attempting to flee as supposed zombies try to get inside. The video has gone viral on social media, claiming that it depicts the zombie virus outbreak in China. It is written on the video, 'Zombie virus has reached Northern China'.
Facebook Post
|
Archive link
Fact Check-
A reverse image search with the key frames of the viral video led us to a larger version of this video on the YouTube page of an Indonesian news website called
'Bangka Pos Official'
. The video was uploaded there on 9August, 2022.
It has been told in the report that this scene is from an event named 'Train to Apocalypse' in Jakarta.
In further search we discovered similar images in a media
report
dated August 2022. According to these reports, the video was part of a campaign to promote public transport in Jakarta, Indonesia. 'Train to Apocalypse,' the campaign was named. The campaign was organised between August 5 and September 11, 2022, by an event company called Pandora Box in partnership with Jakarta's light rail transit agency.
According to
Gulf News
, this event was inspired by the South Korean film 'Train to Busan'. In the film, which was released in 2016, the terror of zombies was shown on a moving train. Based on the
reports
, Jakarta, with a population of over 30 million people, suffers from severe pollution and some of the world's worst traffic congestion. Its light rapid transit system only becomes operational in December 2019.
Taking account of these evidences we can clearly understand that the purpose of attracting the youth towards public transport, the video of the zombie train run in Jakarta is being shared as the attack of zombie virus in China.
Conclusion-
Fact crescendo found the claim made along with this video to be
Misleading
. This video does not show Zombie virus outbreak in China. This video is from a campaign by the rail transit agency in Indonesia to promote the use of public transport.

title: This video does not show French people urinating on an African child
author: Usha Manoj

title: Ananthasayana idol dedicated to Padmanabhaswamy temple in Kerala- know the truth
author: Usha Manoj
content:
Shivanarayana Jewellers created this Ananthasayana idol for Bhima jewellers Chairman Dr. P. Govindan. They created this idol solely for display.
The media frequently reports about worshippers presenting items worth millions and crores to the Gods in places of worship. Now it has come to our attention that a video has been circulating claiming that the Sri Padmanabha Swamy Temple in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala has received a diamond-encrusted Ananthasayana form made of gold.
The Sri Padmanabhaswamy Temple is a Hindu temple, dedicated to Maha Vishnu and it is widely considered as the world's richest Hindu temple. The principal deity is Padmanabhaswamy (Vishnu), who is enshrined in the "Anantha Shayana" posture, the eternal yogic sleep on the infinite serpent Adi Shesha with his right hand on Sivalinga and having a lotus in his left hand.
The video is circulating with the caption "Joy alukkas & Bhima jewellery donated TVM Lord Padmanabha Swamy Temple fully diamond and gold.ANANTHA SAYANAM IDOL."
But on investigation we found that this idol has nothing to do with the Anantha Padmanabhaswamy temple in Thiruvananthapuram and were made by a jeweler in Hyderabad.
Facebook Post
|
Archive link
The post has been widely shared on Facebook.
Fact Check-
We started our investigation by running a reverse image search on Google; the results led us to an Instagram profile of
Sivanarayanan Jewelers
Pvt. A similar video is provided on the page. The caption reads
"
A NEW MASTERPIECE 'SHRI ANANTH PADMANABHASWAMY,' BY SHIV NARAYAN JEWELLERS DEDICATED TO DR. B. GOVINDAN, CHAIRMAN OF BHIMA JEWELLERS THIRUVANANTHAPURAM"
View this post on Instagram
A post shared by Shiv Narayan Jewellers (@shivnarayanjewellerspvtltd)
In further search we found a video report published by
PTI News
on 22 August with the caption "Hyderabad Jeweller aims for 9th entry into Guinness Book with a 2.8 Kg gold and diamond studded idol". The description states Hyderabad-based Shiv Narayan Jewellers unveiled their latest masterpiece, an idol depicting Lord Vishnu in the Yoga Nidra or Yogic Sleep position, inspired by the iconic idol of Shri Anantha Padmanabhaswamy in the temple of the same name in Thiruvananthapuram. The idol measures 8 inches in height and 18 inches in length, and weighs 2.8 kg. It is adorned with over 75,000 high-quality diamonds, totalling an astounding 500 carats".
None of the reports
regarding the circulating video of Ananthapadmanabha swami has given that it was dedicated to Sri Padmanabhaswamy temple. For further clarification we contacted
the Padmanabhaswamy Temple Public Relations Officer
. He clarified:
"
This is completely false news. No one has dedicated such an idol to the Padmanabhaswamy temple and the social media is spreading false propaganda regarding the video".
Also we contacted the Thiruvananthapuram
Bhima Jewellery
Public Relations Office. They explained "False news, this video was circulating on social media with a false claim. We do not undertake any such projects in association with Joyalukkas Jewellery. This is totally a false propaganda; we created this idol solely for display and have no other purpose."
Conclusion-
Fact Crescendo found that the claim along with the viral video to be
False
. Shivanarayana Jewellers created this Anantha Padmanabhaswamy idol for Bhima jewellers Chairman Dr. P. Govindan. The news that Bhima Jewellery and Joy Alukkas Jewellery are donating it to the Padmanabhaswamy Temple is completely false. It has been clarified by both temple officials and Bhima Jewellery.

title: The video showing people sleeping on the road is not from earthquake hit Morocco
author: Usha Manoj
content:

Facebook Post
|
Archive link
Fact Check-
Our investigation began with a reverse image search of key frames from the viral video, which led us to the same video uploaded on a YouTube channel named "Solo Catecumenos" on 6 August, 2023.According to this channel, the video was taken during the 2023 edition of World Youth Day (JMJ2023), an annual Catholic festival held in Lisbon, Portugal.
This indicates that the incident occurred about one month ago and so cannot reflect Morocco's present situation.
In further search we found a report of
France 24
published on 6 August 2023 regarding this event. As per the report over 1.5 million people gathered at Tejo Park in Lisbon on August 5 to participate in World Youth Day presided over by Pope Francis. The event lasted from August 1 to 6, with young Catholics from around the world arriving on August 5, planning to spend the night until the final mass on Sunday. The Pope made his appearance in the 'Popemobile' shortly after 19:00 GMT for this prayer vigil that resembled a giant festival.
We also came across visuals related to this event in a video report of France 24 which shows visuals of attendees sleeping in the open at Tejo Park.
Conclusion
Fact Crescendo found the claim made along with the viral video to be
False
. The viral video is related to World Youth Day, a Catholic festival which took place in Lisbon, Portugal. It does not depict the aftermath of the Morocco earthquake.

title: President rule imposed on the state of Maharashtra? No. This is an old news.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
A video of ABP news reporting on the president's rule in the state of Maharashtra is going viral on social media. It was reported that till the next chief minister of the state takes the oath, the president's rule has been imposed in Maharashtra. All the decisions will be taken by the governor of the state.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. This is old news from 2019 and not a recent incident.
What's the claim?
Sharing the video, social media users are claiming that the president's rule was imposed on the state of Maharashtra till a new government was formed.
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
A relevant keyword search on YouTube led us to the same news reported by
ABP
in 2019. According to the report, after the 2019 elections BJP failed to prove the majority which resulted in the imposing of the president's rule in the state. It was mentioned, "Shiv Sena expressed willingness but could not prove ability and asked for an extension, Congress
did not reply in time whereas NCP continued to say that they were initiating talks with Congress in order to achieve the required number.Despite the governor giving 24 hours' time to NCP, the President's Rule has been imposed and amid all this, people suffer
"
According to the
Times of India
report in 2019, after Governor Bhagat Singh Koshyari failed to form the government in Maharashtra, President Ram Nath Kovind imposed the president's rule in the state. This took place after the Governor reported that no political parties in the state were in a position to form a stable government. In his report to the President, he cited his unsuccessful efforts to form a coalition government by making alliances.
Apart from all this, we also heard in the video that the name of the governor was mentioned as Bhagat Singh Koshyari. Upon searching, we found that the current
Governor of Maharashtra
is Ramesh Bias who was sworn in as the governor in February 2023,
From the above facts, it is clear that an old video is being shared as the current situation in Maharashtra where President's rule has been imposed.
The second part of the video claimed that recently Lalu Prasad Yadav called PM Modi as NRI and criticized his foreign tours.
A keyword search on YouTube led us to the same news reported by ABP in 2014. Lalu Yadav can be heard saying, "Modi once said that Chinese and Pakistani army will not dare to come face to face with India but when he was doing his programs in Sabarmati, Chinese soldiers were destroying Indian bunkers."
Although it is true that Lalu Yadav criticized PM Modi but this is an old incident from 2014 and not a recent one.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. Both the clips in the viral video are old. The news on the President's rule in Maharashtra is from 2019 while the news about Lalu Yadav calling PM Modi is from 2014.

title: Rahul Gandhi is not talking about unemployment among eagles in his speech.

After watching the entire video, we found that Rahul Gandhi did not blame Modi and BJP for the unemployment of eagles in his speech. The viral video has been edited. In the viral video Rahul Gandhi made following three statements:
Explain one thing to me, what are these eagles and why are they flying here? What are these eagles doing here? Can anyone tell me? These birds are flying here, why are they flying here?
Since last 5 years they are unemployed
The reason for this is Modi and RSS

From
9.37 minutes

Young people don't understand that for so many years they studied and passed exams in school, college, university. But they failed to get employment for the last 5 years. In any country, if the youth and the new generation do not see their future then anger arises in their hearts. Narendra Modi is reaping the benefits of that anger. But the main cause of anger is unemployment.

From the 1st minute of the original video, Rahul Gandhi said:
You must have seen that India's environment had deteriorated significantly in the last few years. The unity, brotherhood and peace that was there earlier are nowhere to be seen now. Does everyone know the reason for this? Many will say that it is because of Narendra Modi, RSS or BJP. But I want to say something different. title: Canada has not banned RSS â€“ viral claim is false
author: Usha Manoj
content:
Canada has not banned RSS. The viral video shows the CEO of the National Council for Canadian Muslims making some demands. He has no link to the Canadian government.
Diplomatic relations between India and Canada have been affected by the recent assassination of a Sikh leader in Canada. |

Fact check
A reverse image search on the keyframes of the video led us to a longer version of a video uploaded on a YouTube channel named
NCCMTV on 20 September.
It reads, "NCCM CEO Stephen Brown Calls for Action in Response to Alleged Assassination of Sikh Man in Canada". He made several demands in his speech. One of them is to ban the RSS in the country.
In further search we found an old tweet from INC (Immigration News Canada) which shows Stephen Brown addressing the media as well making the same claims.
ðŸ‡¨ðŸ‡¦ Stephen Brown, CEO of the National Council for Canadian Muslims and Balpreet Singh, legal counsel for the World Sikh Organization of Canada calls on the Canadian Government to do 4 more things

Keeping this in mind, we searched with some relevant keywords and discovered that NCCM stands for

. We checked the official website of the National Council of Canadian Muslims and found that it is "an independent, independent and non-profit organization born right out of Canada's Muslim community". The organization's website does not indicate that it has any affiliation with the Canadian government. Therefore, the underlying claim that NCCM is affiliated with the Government of Canada is not true. Stephen Brown is not a government official. Fact crescendo found that the claim made along the video is
False

title: Fake notice of Golden Temple goes viral
author: Usha Manoj
content:

A notice allegedly from Amritsar's Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib)has gone viral on social media, amid rising tensions between India and Canada over the Khalistan issue, particularly among the Sikh community in Canada. According to the viral notice, all overseas gurudwaras must immediately cease supporting any anti-India activity that calls for a separate nation and supports any form of terrorism using the Sikh religion, particularly the banned terrorist group Babbar Khalsa International.
The notice reads, "We condemn any form of terrorism by Babbar Khalsa International and other organizations using Sikh religion to defame India. The Sikh community in India don't need any coward agents residing abroad, demanding justice or a separate nation for us. The majority of Punjab still resides in Pakistan, including the Nankana Saheb. The terrorist organizations have never demanded the larger Punjab in Pakistan, which exposes their real anti-Indian intentions. Such organisations also kept quiet when our Sikh community was under attack in Afghanistan, and never provided any help or justice, which is their motto. We request entire Sikh community in India to follow the democratic path to achieve any political aspirations and vicissitudes for our community. The Sikh community stands with our beloved motherland for whom, our great Guru's have sacrificed their lives to protect the unity, integrity and sovereignty of it. We hereby notify that, all international Gurudwaras must immediately stop supporting any form of Anti-Indian movement, which demands for a separate nation and supports any form of Terrorism using Sikh religion."
Twitter link
|
Archive link
Fact Check-
We first searched for news reports on the Golden Temple which mentioned a notice of this kind, but did not come across any credible articles. The Shiromani Gurdwara Parbhandak Committee (
SGPC
) is a body which is responsible for the management of Sikh places of worship in Punjab, Chandigarh and Himachal Pradesh. Later we looked on the SGPC's website for any announcements or notices like the one referenced in the claim, but we were not able to find anything. We even checked their social media handles also but could find any relevant post.
For further clarification we reached out to the SPGC office and they informed us that, "It is fake. No such official document has been issued by us".
A notice with the Golden Temple's letterhead condemning any form of terrorism by Babbar Khalsa International and other organizations using Sikh religion to defame India was found to be fake.
Conclusion
â€“
Fact Crescendo found that a fake notice is being falsely linked to the Golden Temple. No such notice was issued, governing body of the Golden Temple (SGPC) clarified that it was fake.

title: False information related to Manmohan Singh and Rahul Gandhi Shared to defame them.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
Currently, a post with the birthdays of former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, Sonia Gandhi, Rahul Gandhi, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi is going viral on social media. However, Fact Crescendo found that the claim is not completely true. The birthdays of Dr. Manmohan Singh and Rahul Gandhi were falsely shared to defame them.

|

Claim 1: Dr. Manmohan Singh's birthday and International Blind-Deaf Day falls on the same date

Manmohan Singh
was born on 26 September 1932 in the Punjab province of the undivided India. He served as Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014.
According to
Britannica
, Manmohan Singh was born on 26 September. On 26 September
NDTV
reported that Prime Minister Narendra Modi wished Manmohan Singh his 91
st
birthday on the same day.
But, does International Blind-Deaf Day fall on 26 September? According to
the World Federation of the Blind Deaf (WFBD)
, 27 June is celebrated as the International Day of Deafblindness to increase public awareness of people with deafblindness and their rights.
Hence, it is clear that former Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh's birthday and International Deafblindness Day does not fall on same date.
Claim 2: Sonia Gandhi's Birthday and International Anti-Corruption Day fall on 9 December.
According to
The Times of India
report, on 9 December 2022, Sonia Gandhi celebrated her birthday in Ranthambore in Rajasthan with Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi during Bharat Jodo Yatra.
Mallikarjun Kharge, President of Indian National Congress also wished Sonia Gandhi on her birthday on 9 December 2022. Below you can see his tweet.
Extending my warm birthday greetings to CPP Chairperson, Smt. Sonia Gandhi ji.
Her grace, dedication indomitable spirit and dignity in the wake of adversity has inspired millions.
I wish her a long and healthy life.
â€” Mallikarjun Kharge (@kharge)
December 9, 2022
We also found that
United Nations
designated 9 December as International Anti-Corruption Day to raise awareness of corruption and how to prevent and combat it. This day became effective in 2005.
Thus, we can say that Sonia Gandhi's birthday and International Anti-Corruption Day fall on the same date.
Claim 3: Rahul Gandhi's Birthday and the movie Mera Naam Joker fall on the same date.
As per the information available on
Indian National Congress
website, Rahul Gandhi was born on 19 June 1970.
According to
IMDB
, the movie 'Mera Naam Joker' was released on 18 December 1970. The same movie was released in Brazil and in Peru in 1982, in 1974 and 1982 it was released in Argentina and in Turkey respectively.
Thus, it is clear that Mera Naam Joker did not release on the same day Rahul Gandhi was born.
Claim 4: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Birthday and Vishwakarma Jayanti fall on the same day.
We found that Prime Minister
Narendra Modi
was born on 17 September 1950 in Gujarat's Vadnagar. This year on his 73
rd
birthday many ministers wished him and a digital celebration was also organized on this occasion.
We also found that
Vishwakarma Jayanti
falls on 17
th
or 18
th
of September every year according to the Hindu calendar. This year Vishwakarma Jayanti was celebrated on 17 September, the day of PM Modi's birthday.
Thus, it is true that Vishwakarma Jayanti and PM Modi's birthday fall on the same date.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found that the claim is partially false. Although Sonia Gandhi and PM Modi's birthday fall on the same date and occasion as claimed in the post but, information related to birthdays of Manmohan Singh and Rahul Gandhi is false.

title: This video does not show three generations of Russian gymnasts performing together
author: Usha Manoj
content:
The video depicts a team of Russian gymnasts who are not related to each other. The video was shot at the 2010 Acrobatic Gymnastics World Championships.
A video featuring the performance of three Russian female gymnasts has gone viral on social media with the claim that these gymnasts represent three generations from the same family.
The caption of the video states "What a pedigree! Three generations of Russian Gymnasts performing together. Grandmother, mother and daughter. The tallest one is the grandmother! All in gene: Now we know"
Facebook Post
|
Archive link
The video has been widely shared on Facebook.
Fact Check-
A Google reverse image search using the key frames from the viral video led us to the longer version of the similar video uploaded on YouTube on 15 November 2013 with the title "Acrobatic Gymnastics World Championships 2010 â€“ Russia Women's Group 1st place".
Keeping this in mind, we analysed the video carefully and found at the beginning of the video, the names of the Russian gymnasts are identified as Aigul Shaikhutdinova, Ekaterina Stroynova, and Ekaterina Loginov.
In further search we came across a
report
that included the same video. According to the report, the performance took place during the 2010 Acrobatic Gymnastics World Championships.
The trio secured the top position in the women's group category at the
2010 championship
, earning them the first prize. The report does not mention the three individuals being related. Additionally, our search did not yield any information confirming that these gymnasts are indeed from the same family.
According to the
Russian Federation for Aerobatics
' record the three gymnasts Aigul Shaikhutdinova, Stroynova, and Loginov were born in 1994, 1987, and 1985, respectively.
This information confirms that these three gymnasts are not related to each other, as claimed in the post.
Conclusion-
Fact Crescendo found the claim made along with the video to be False. The video depicts a team of Russian gymnasts who are not related to each other. The video was shot at the 2010 Acrobatic Gymnastics World Championships.

title: Ashok Gehlot's government pay only 5 lakhs as compensation to Kanhaiya Lal's family after his murder? Know the truth.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
A few days back, an 18-year-old boy from a minority community lost his life in a fight after an accident in Rajasthan. The state government announced a compensation of 50 lakhs rupees and a contractual job for the victim's family.
In the backdrop of this, an image of a cheque of 50 lakh rupees issued in the name of Naima Parveen is going viral on social media. As the victim was from a minority community, netizens are claiming that the Congress government in Rajasthan is biased. The government issued 50 lakh rupees in compensation for a minority family but issued only 5 lakh rupees in the Kanhaiya Lal murder case.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. A compensation of 50 lakh rupees was also given to Kanhaiya Lal's family.
What's the claim?
Social media users are claiming that "the government has announced compensation of 50 lakh rupees for Iqbal who was killed in a personal fight in Ramganj, Jaipur, and 5 lakh compensation was given when Kanhaiya Lal was murdered in Udaipur. This is the discrimination of Congress."
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
A Google keyword search led us to a
notice
released by the Rajasthan government on 30 June 2022 after Kanhaiya Lal's murder. It was mentioned that CM Ashok Gehlot visited the late Kanhaiya Lal's house and paid tribute to his picture. Later, he met his family and assured them of fast justice and harsh punishment for the culprits. On the Chief Minister's instruction, minister of State for Home, Shri Rajendra Yadav presented a cheque of 50 lakhs to Kanhaiya Lal's family.
On 30 June 2022,
The Free Press Journal
reported that, CM Ashok Gehlot met deceased Kanhaiya Lal's family and stayed with them for a while. He met Kanhaiya Lal's wife and son and gave them a cheque of 50 lakhs rupees from the government. He also promised a government job to the deceased's son. He demanded a fast-track probe into Kanhaiya Lal's murder case and harsh punishment for the culprits within a month.
Navbharat Times, on its YouTube Channel, reported that CM Ashok Gehlot went to the deceased tailor Kanhaiya Lal's house. He gave a cheque of 51 lakhs rupees to the victim's family and announced a government job to both the sons of Kanhaiya Lal
What is the recent case?
According to a
report
, a fight broke out between two bikers after they collided with each other in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The residents of the locality tried to stop the fight but the victim started fighting with them as well and the other person on the bike fled from the place. 18-year-old Iqbal lost his life in the fight. Police and Special Task Force (STF) rushed to the spot. The state government had announced a compensation of 50 lakhs rupees, a dairy booth, and a contractual job to the victim's family.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. A cheque of 50 lakhs rupees was given to Kanhaiya Lal's family after his demise last year and not 5 lakhs.

Panjab Kesari's Jammu & Kashmir Facebook page shared the below image as breaking news along with the caption that reads â€“

Facebook

In December 2014, Avner Netanyahu, the youngest son of Israel's prime minister, began his mandatory military service in the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). Times of Isreal

Avner Netanyahu

In conclusion, the claim suggesting that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sent his son to fight against Hamas in the current conflict is inaccurate. The image is from 2014 when Avner Netanyahu began his military service in the IDF, and it is not connected to the current events.

title: That Palestinians Faking Injuries Through Make-Up Is False; Read Fact Check
author: Mayur Deokar
content:
In the midst of the ongoing conflict between Israel and Hamas, social media have flooded with misinformation and misleading content. A common issue is the manipulation of online videos, often taken out of context to spread a false narrative.
One such video showing people putting on make-up is going viral with a claim that people in Palestine are faking injuries to portray themselves as victims of Israeli attacks.
Fact Crescendo received this video with fact-check requests on our
WhatsApp Tipline (9049053770)
.
We found that the viral video is old and is actually footage from a film set. Using it to claim that Palestinians are deliberately staging injuries is both misleading and false.
WHAT'S THE CLAIM?
The viral video features a makeup artist applying fake blood and creating injuries on people. This 23-second clip has been widely shared on social media with a caption that reads:
"How to FOOL UNITED NATION in believing that Palestinians & Gaza people are victims. And that Hamas is a peaceful organization that didn't kill 1700 News in Israel. Welcome to ISLAMIC UNIVERSITY of CRAFT."
It has been claimed that the video is proof of how Palestinians deceive the United Nations into believing that people in Gaza are victims.
https://twitter.com/teamsanatani6/status/1713007320207409383
Archive
FACT-CHECK
Using keyword search, we found a news report on the Turkish news channel TRT World uploaded in 2017 that features the same video clip.
According to the report, it is from a film set of a project by the Doctors of the World organization. The news segment highlights the story of Mariam Salah, a makeup artist in the Gaza Strip, and her choice to work in a field predominantly occupied by men.
The news anchor in the report mentions, "We're on a film set in the Gaza Strip. Make-up artist Maryam Salah is creating horrific looking injuries on actors taking part in a project by French charity Doctors of the World. They hope to raise awareness of the dangers faced by Gaza residents."
The viral video is actually from a behind-the-scenes recording of a film set back in 2017, and it bears no connection to the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict.
In recent reports, the toll from Israeli air attacks on Gaza has resulted in at least 1,900 Palestinians killed and 7,696 wounded, while in Israel, the number of casualties stands at 1,300 killed and 3,400 wounded.
On Friday, Israel's military mandated the evacuation of 1.1 million individuals in northern Gaza within a 24-hour period.
CONCLUSION
The viral video clip is actually footage from a film set in 2017 and has no relation to the ongoing Israeli-Gaza conflict. The claim that Palestinians are staging fake injuries to manipulate public perception is false. Misleading claims can spread misinformation and hamper efforts to understand and address the complex realities of these situations.

title: Is this a video showing the manufacturing of artificial wheat from plastics? Know the truth.
author: Siddharth Sahu
content:
Currently, a video is going viral on social media in which plastics of huge quantities are put into machines and small granules are manufactured from it. In this video, we can see a man putting plastics in machines and before the final product, the plastics undergo various processes.
Users are claiming that this is the video of the production of fake wheat from the plastics that are now being sold in the market.
However, Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. This is not a video of production of fake wheat. This is a video of recycling of plastics.
Facebook
|
Archive
Fact Check-
We noticed that a watermark 'Smartest worker' was visible in the video.
A Google Keyword search revealed that the video was uploaded on 24 September by an Instagram account carrying the same 'Smartest Worker' name. It was mentioned that this is a video of recycling of the waste plastics. The caption of the post reads, 'Plastic's New Purpose: Unveiling the Recycling Journey'
View this post on Instagram
A post shared by Smartest Workers (@smartest.worker)
After going through the Smartest Worker's Instagram account, we found that the user had uploaded many similar videos of recycling things. You can check the Instagram account
here
.
How is plastic recycled?
First, the plastics are cleaned with a 'dust cleaner machine'. After this, these are put into a 'scrap grinder machine' and cut into small pieces. These pieces are placed in a machine called 'washing conveyor' which cleans them. Next, the wet plastic pieces are put into a 'film dryer machine' to dry them. These dried pieces are then fed into an 'Agglomerator Machine' where they are further chopped and ground. From there it is put into the 'heating barrel'. Then it is cooled with water and put into a cutter and granules of plastics are made.
Conclusion:
Fact Crescendo found the claim to be false. This is not a video of manufacturing of plastic wheat. This is a video of recycling of waste plastics.
